description: Job posting parser (AI) — Turn a job posting into structured JSON: title, company, location, workplace (remote/hybrid/onsite), employment type, seniority, salary range with period and annualized pay (kept only when the numbers appear in the posting), years of experience, education, required and preferred skills, responsibilities, benefits, deadline, visa sponsorship, one-line summary, plus an offline job-scam check (upfront fees, gift cards, check deposits, chat-app hiring, reshipping) with scamRisk LOW / REVIEW / HIGH. Params: text (the posting) or url (a job page; text is extracted first). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: Senior Backend Engineer at Acme (Remote, US). $150,000 - $180,000 per year. 5+ years Python, PostgreSQL, AWS required; Kubernetes a plus. Health, 401k, unlimited PTO.

name: ai_job_parse
